title: A special case
description:
The general `toText` turns numbers into text with `std::to_string`. That gives `"1"` for `true`, which is not what anybody wants.

Add a **full specialization** of `toText` for `bool` that returns `"true"` or `"false"`. A specialization is written `template <>` followed by the function with the concrete type filled in.
unitTests:
TEST("the general version") { CHECK_EQ(toText(42), "42"); CHECK_EQ(toText(-7L), "-7"); }
TEST("the bool specialization") { CHECK_EQ(toText(true), "true"); CHECK_EQ(toText(false), "false"); }

grading.unitTests:
